title: Plot to present the VCaP cancer cell line
text: section, try draw pictures real publications. literature (Alves et al., 2013) uses plot similar Figure present VCaP cancer cell line. outermost ring corresponds human chromosome ideograms (Figure ). serves X-axis indicate position data rings chromosome. inner ring Figure B represents number gene copies, value dot Affymetrix SNP arrays. Y-axis range −1 1, dots 0.15 1 marked red, dots −0.15 0.15 marked grey, dots −1 0.15 marked green. inner ring Figure C represents B-allele frequency (ratio), ranges 0 1 Y-axis. links plot used reflect structural variations (SVs) (Figure D). intra- inter-chromosomal SVs inner rings depicted black red lines, respectively. red link lines obscured black link lines quite intra-chromosomal SVs. red link lines reduced scale (Figure E) aesthetic reasons. Combining plots together gives picture literature (Figure F).
code: library(circlizePlus) params = ccPar(start.degree=90) data("example2") #Fig. A cc = ccPlot(initMode="initializeWithIdeogram", species ="hg18", plotType = c("ideogram",  "labels")) cc + params #Fig. B copy_number_track=ccGenomicTrack(data=copy_number, ylim=c(-1,1), numeric.column = 4, bg.lwd=0.1, panel.fun = function(region, value, ...) {     colors=value     colors$col="gray"     colors[colors$Value < -0.15,]$col="red"     colors[colors$Value > 0.15,]$col="green"     circos.genomicPoints(region, value, pch=20,cex=0.1, col = colors$col,...) }) cc + params + copy_number_track #Fig. C allele_frequency_track=ccGenomicTrack(data=allele_frequency, ylim=c(0,1), numeric.column = 4, bg.lwd=0.1) all_cell = ccCells(sector.indexes = unique(allele_frequency[[1]])) + ccGenomicPoints(pch=20,cex=0.1,col="gray") allele_frequency_track=allele_frequency_track+all_cell cc + params + allele_frequency_track #Fig. D junctions$col="black" junctions[junctions$LeftChr!=junctions$RightChr,]$col="red" links = ccGenomicLink(region1=r1, region2=r2,col=junctions$col,h.ratio=0.6, lwd=0.1) cc + params + links #Fig. E junctions$rou=0.85 junctions[junctions$LeftChr!=junctions$RightChr,]$rou=0.45 links = ccGenomicLink(region1=r1, region2=r2,col=junctions$col,h.ratio=0.6, lwd=0.1, rou=junctions$rou) cc + params + links #Fig. F junctions$rou=0.42 junctions[junctions$LeftChr!=junctions$RightChr,]$rou=0.22 links = ccGenomicLink(region1=r1, region2=r2,col=junctions$col,h.ratio=0.6, lwd=0.1, rou=junctions$rou) cc + params +copy_number_track + allele_frequency_track + links
